title: Deterministic physics rule-list model: full-corpus run + atomic latency
why: Q1 proved the deterministic rule list on 150 in-domain IndEgo gold windows; Q5 asks what it does at scale over the whole 1,546-window Egocentric-10K corpus, with atomic per-stage timing, verified receipt determinism, and an explicit determinism/OOD trade-off against the logistic runs (L2/L3) and E8.01.
hypothesis: The rules are cheap; swapping only the decision stage of the L3 latency runner leaves decode/features/EG2 untouched, so the full corpus runs at the same feature-bound throughput with a near-zero decision cost and byte-identical receipts across repeats.
data: queues/manifest_scale.json: 1546 windows / 58 clips / 4.404 h, 1080p30 HEVC; label_source none (no human labels); rule table frozen from Q1 (7 IndEgo clips)
regime: factory Egocentric-10K, 1080p, 30 fps, HEVC, handheld egocentric manufacturing; rules derived in-domain (480p IndEgo)
method: L3 runner (eval/exp_latency_fast/run_fast.py) with the decision stage swapped to eval/exp_phys/phys_rules.py + rule_table.json; extra atomic phys_features stage (jadal.perpixel.physics.extract_physics); adopted opts pixel 3.33 fps / EG2 1 fps / 4 s early exit / mosaic off; 7 workers, JADAL_GPU_SLOTS=6, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, A40 NVDEC; receipt_sha256 hashes the line excluding latency_ms

summary: n=1544/1546 windows (58 clips, 4.404 h), 2 transient NVDEC decode errors (factory_003, peer contention). Deterministic rules over the full corpus: reject 1537 (99.55%), review 7 (0.45%), accept 0; every-2nd policy reject 771 / review 1 of 772. Score p50 31 vs reject_threshold 14; rules fire on 95-100% of windows (CODING_NOISE, FROZEN_STATIC 100%; OVEREXPOSED 98%; NO_ACTIVE_WORK 97%; DUPLICATE 96%). Determinism: 10/10 sampled windows give byte-identical receipt_sha256 AND features_digest across two repeats. Throughput: wall 1067 s at 7 workers = 1.45 windows/s, 14.86 footage-h/wall-hour, 4503 ms/window (p50 4283, p95 6319). Stage shares: decode 76.1%, descriptors 10.6%, EG2 6.1%, phys_features 4.9%, pixel_features 2.2%, decision 0.06% (2.6 ms). Per-window verdict agreement with E8.01 5.76% (kappa 0.0008) and with L3 2.85% (kappa 0.0009); binary reject-vs-not vs E8.01 5.83% (both reject 83, Q5-reject-only 1454). The IndEgo-quantile thresholds do not transfer out-of-domain.
decision: Keep the rule list as the in-domain deterministic scorer (Q1 AUROC 0.822 vs logistic 0.802); do NOT deploy its IndEgo thresholds on Egocentric-10K without per-regime re-quantiling or a label-free normalisation. The rules are free (decision 2.6 ms, 0.06% of the window); the window is decode/feature-bound.
cost: 7 workers x 1067 s (17.8 min) on a shared A40; 1546 windows x (160x90 pixel @3.33 fps + EG2 @1 fps + 8 native descriptor frames + 16 physics features); 1 ffmpeg/NVDEC pass and 1 EG2 forward per window; pipes only, no extra storage
